mainEntity.name: What should I consider before selecting a new bathroom vanity countertop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before selecting a new countertop, consider its durability, maintenance requirements, and how it complements your chosen vanity cabinet and overall bathroom style. Materials like quartz and granite are highly durable and resistant to scratches and heat, while marble offers a luxurious look but requires more sealing and care. Also, factor in the edge profile and sink type (undermount, drop-in, or vessel) you prefer, as these choices influence both aesthetics and functionality. This decision factor impacts the longevity and daily usability of your vanity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider durability, maintenance, style, and sink type when choosing a countertop; materials like quartz and granite are durable, while marble offers luxury but needs more care.
